items.headline: GitLab reported Q1 FY2027 results with revenue of about $264.2M, then announced a restructuring plan cutting about 14% of staff and exiting 22 countries
GitLab’s board approved a $400M share repurchase program and the company said it had already used $50M to retire shares
GitLab’s Q1 FY2027 earnings beat expectations and the company raised full-year guidance, with management highlighting demand for AI offerings
